programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk and the power failure / Mr. Monk und der Stromausfall
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

The meticulous suit runner succeeds in loosening the case together with his colleagues on site. They absolutely want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like the sea fruit. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga

Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Ice Hockey - KHL
programme.desc: The strongest hockey hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called KHL or a continental hockey league. Only the competition was created from the Russian Super League in 2008. programme.title: Baseball - MLB / Bejzbol - MLB
programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest rank of baseball league in North America. League beginners already before the end of the 19th century, in 1876. When the first season of the Netherlands' first season was played. In 1903. Today's structure was formed with the first edition of "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 matches. Out of a total of eight teams that select the Plejof two best play "World Series Final". The winner is the one who arrives first to four victories in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

Това е многодневно състезание, което обикновено се провежда в края на лятото и привлича топ колоездачи от целия свят. Германия е известна със своите красиви и разнообразни маршрути, които предлагат както равнинни етапи, така и сериозни планински изкачвания, което прави състезанието изключително вълнуващо и оспорвано.

Global warming is attacked with a radical experiment that should be reduced to their levels from the pre -senior era. / 1еп.: "Слънцеотразяващ космически щит": Целта на експеримент, предложен от професор Роджър Ейнджъл, е да се отклонят от Земята 2 % от слънчевите лъчи, за да се спаси човечеството от фаталните климатични промени. programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. programme.title: Marjorie Prime
programme.desc: In the near future, 85-year-old Marjorie has the first symptoms of Alzheimer's disease. Her daughter Tess and Zet Jon hired a service called Prima, which helps the patients with Alzheimer's disease by creating a hologram projection of deceased family members and thus feed them with memories that patients lose. Marjorie chooses a hologram projection of her deceased husband Walter, but in the younger version. Walter Prime becomes curious and asks Jon to tell him as many details about Walter's life. Jon then begins to reveal family secrets that Marjorie should not find out ... / U skoroj budućnosti, 85-godišnja Marjorie ima prve simptome Alzheimerove bolesti. Njezina kći Tess i zet Jon angažiraju službu nazvanu Prime koja pomaže oboljelima od Alzheimerove bolesti tako što stvaraju hologramske projekcije preminulih članova obitelji i tako ih hrane sjećanjima koje bolesnici gube. Marjorie odabire hologramsku projekciju svog preminulog supruga Waltera, ali u mlađoj verziji. Walter Prime postaje znatiželjan i traži od Jona da mu ispriča što više detalja o Walterovom životu. Jon tada počinje otkrivati obiteljske tajne koje Marjorie ne bi smjela saznati...

programme.desc: The true story of the infamous escape of Gary Tison and Randy Greenwalt from the Arizona State Prison in the summer of 1978. / Istinita priča o zloglasnom bijegu Garyja Tisona i Randyja Greenwalta iz državnog zatvora u Arizoni u ljeto 1978. godine.

programme.title: All roads water in Rome / Svi putevi vode u Rim
programme.desc: Meggie is a single mother from New York, who goes on a trip to Tuscany with her rebellious daughter Summer. There he meets his ex -husband, from whom Summer steals the car and runs into Rome. The adventurous search for Summer begins in which former lovers reveal mutual understanding. / Meggie je samohrana majka iz New Yorka koja kreće na put u Toskanu sa svojom buntovnom kćeri Summer. Ondje susreće svojeg bivšeg supruga od kojega Summer krade automobil i bježi u Rim. Počinje avanturistička potraga za Summer u kojoj bivši ljubavnici iznova otkrivaju uzajamno razumijevanje.

programme.title: Jocker
programme.desc: Nick Wild, a bodyguard and a dice addict, embarks on a vengeful march when his friend rapes a disturbed bully. But what Nick does not know is that the abuser is the son of a powerful mafia boss. The roles are now higher than ever because only one can survive this game. / Nick Wild, tjelohranitelj i ovisnik o kocki, kreće u osvetnički pohod kada njegovu prijateljicu siluje poremećeni nasilnik. No ono što Nick ne zna je da je zlostavljač sin moćnog mafijaškog šefa. Ulozi su sad viši nego ikada jer ovu igru može preživjeti samo jedan.

programme.title: Calculation in Manila / Obračun u Manili
programme.desc: Private Detectives Nick and Charlie work in the capital of Philippines - Manili. Exploring the murder case The road leads them into the jungle where there is a terrorist camp. Demanding confidence in the police, detectives gather their team of elite fighters to destroy terrorists with whom they share them bad memories from the past. / Privatni detektivi Nick i Charlie rade u glavnom gradu Filipina – Manili. Istražujući slučaj ubojstva put ih vodi u džunglu gdje se nalazi teroristički kamp. Nemajući povjerenja u policiju, detektivi okupljaju svoj tim elitnih boraca kako bi uništili teroriste s kojima ih dijele loše uspomene iz prošlosti.

programme.title: Sirenina priča
programme.desc: Contemporary fairy tale, the story of Ryan, a 12-year-old girl who is forced to move with Matt, her father, with the artisy grandfather Alan to the dilapidated fishing town where she was born. As he tries to fit in, he finds new friends and reveals a secret bay, Dom Dolphin and Coral, a mysterious girl. After befriends, Ryan learns that Coral Siren is, and together they come to know the secret that will help girls to save the city. / Suvremena bajka, priča o Ryan, 12-godišnjoj djevojčici koja je prisiljena preseliti se s Mattom, njenim ocem, kod čangrizavog djeda Alana u oronuli ribarski gradić gdje je rođena. Kako se pokušava uklopiti, pronalazi nove prijatelje i otkriva tajnu uvalu, dom delfina i Coral, misteriozne djevojke. Nakon što se sprijatelje, Ryan saznaje da je Coral sirena, a one zajedno spoznaju tajnu koja će pomoći djevojkama da spase grad.

programme.title: Veza bez obaveza
programme.desc: Lainey and Jake met in the dormitory in the dormitory and have common memories. Their re -encounter occurred on therapy. They entrusted to each other their sexual problems, and Jake confessed to her that she wanted to sleep with her. Lainey decided it was not time to do it but that the two would hang out as friends ... / Lainey i Jake su se sreli davnih dana u studentskom domu i imaju zajedničke uspomene. Njihov ponovni susret dogodio se na terapiji. Povjerili su jedno drugome svoje seksualne probleme, a Jake joj je priznao da želi s njom spavati. Lainey je odlučila da nije vrijeme za to nego da će se njih dvoje družiti kao prijatelji...

programme.title: Bujica
programme.desc: One night, after finding a woman cheating on him, Alexandre accidentally kills her. Worried that the police will not believe in an accident, they decide to hide the truth. / Jedne noći, nakon što otkrije da ga žena vara, Alexandre je slučajno ubije. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: UEFA European Under -21 Championship Qualification - (Sport. Program, 2025) U21 European Football Championship is a competition under the organization of UEFA and is held every two years. At the final of the main competition, the right of performing is achieved by 12 teams, hosts and the 11 best teams that successfully perform a qualifying cycle. A total of 54 teams enter the qualifying drum and are arranged in nine groups of six national teams. All teams in the group play each other's home meetings and away. Nine first -ranked national teams in each group achieve a direct placement on the finals, while the four best runner -up national teams over the Playoff Love in the last two places in the final of the European Championship ... / UEFA European Under-21 Championship Qualification - (sport. program, 2025) U21 Europsko nogometno prvenstvo natjecanje je pod organizacijom UEFE te se održava svake dvije godine. Na završnicu glavnog natjecanja pravo nastupa ostvaruje 12 momčadi, domaćin te 11 najboljih reprezentacija koje uspješno odrade kvalifikacijski ciklus. Ukupno 54 momčadi ulazi u bubanj kvalifikacija te su raspoređene u devet grupa po šest reprezentacija. Sve reprezentacije u skupini odigraju međusobne susrete doma i u gostima. Devet prvoplasiranih reprezentacija u svakoj grupi ostvaruju izravan plasman na završnicu dok četiri najbolje drugoplasirane reprezentacije preko playoffa love posljednja dva mjesta u završnici Europskog prvenstva...

programme.title: (U -19): Croatia - Germany, football, friendly match / (U-19): Hrvatska - Njemačka, Nogomet, Prijateljska utakmica
programme.desc: Football: Club Friendly - (Sport. Program, 2025) club seasons in most of the world leagues are divided by two parts, autumn and spring. At the time of summer and winter, the clubs are in the preparatory period and complement the difficult rhythm of training by playing preparatory friendly matches. Friendly meetings are a great way to test the current team of teams and temptation of different tactical variants for the upcoming official matches. Also, they are an opportunity for younger non -affirmed players from the second plan to impose themselves with a professional frame. In friendly meetings, the emphasis is on Fair Play and coaches are allowed to make an unlimited number of changes ... / Football: Club Friendly - (sport. program, 2025) Klupske sezone u većini svjetskih liga podijeljene su dva dijela, jesenski i proljetni. U vrijeme ljeta i zime klubovi su u pripremnom razdoblju te težak ritam treninga upotpunjuju odigravanjem pripremnih prijateljskih utakmica. Prijateljski susreti odličan su način za ispitivanje trenutne snage momčadi i iskušavanje različitih taktičkih varijanti za nadolazeće službene utakmice. Također, prilika su za mlađe neafirmirane igrače iz drugog plana za nametnuti se stručnom kadru. U prijateljskim susretima naglasak je na fair playu te je trenerima dozvoljeno napraviti neograničeni broj izmjena...

programme.desc: Football - Croatian Cup - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025) The Croatian Cup is the most massive football competition in Croatia. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. programme.title: (U -18): Italy - Croatia, football, friendly match / (U-18): Italija - Hrvatska, Nogomet, Prijateljska utakmica
programme.desc: Football: Club Friendly - (Sport. Program, 2025) club seasons in most of the world leagues are divided by two parts, autumn and spring. At the time of summer and winter, the clubs are in the preparatory period and complement the difficult rhythm of training by playing preparatory friendly matches. Friendly meetings are a great way to test the current team of teams and temptation of different tactical variants for the upcoming official matches. Also, they are an opportunity for younger non -affirmed players from the second plan to impose themselves with a professional frame. In friendly meetings, the emphasis is on Fair Play and coaches are allowed to make an unlimited number of changes ... / Football: Club Friendly - (sport. program, 2025) Klupske sezone u većini svjetskih liga podijeljene su dva dijela, jesenski i proljetni. U vrijeme ljeta i zime klubovi su u pripremnom razdoblju te težak ritam treninga upotpunjuju odigravanjem pripremnih prijateljskih utakmica. Prijateljski susreti odličan su način za ispitivanje trenutne snage momčadi i iskušavanje različitih taktičkih varijanti za nadolazeće službene utakmice. Također, prilika su za mlađe neafirmirane igrače iz drugog plana za nametnuti se stručnom kadru. U prijateljskim susretima naglasak je na fair playu te je trenerima dozvoljeno napraviti neograničeni broj izmjena...

programme.title: (U-21): Turkey - Croatia, football, EP U21 qualifications / (U-21): Turska - Hrvatska, Nogomet, Kvalifikacije za EP U21
programme.desc: UEFA European Under -21 Championship Qualification - (Sport. Program, 2025) U21 European Football Championship is a competition under the organization of UEFA and is held every two years. At the final of the main competition, the right of performing is achieved by 12 teams, hosts and the 11 best teams that successfully perform a qualifying cycle. A total of 54 teams enter the qualifying drum and are arranged in nine groups of six national teams. All teams in the group play each other's home meetings and away. Nine first -ranked national teams in each group achieve a direct placement on the finals, while the four best runner -up national teams over the Playoff Love in the last two places in the final of the European Championship ... / UEFA European Under-21 Championship Qualification - (sport. program, 2025) U21 Europsko nogometno prvenstvo natjecanje je pod organizacijom UEFE te se održava svake dvije godine. Na završnicu glavnog natjecanja pravo nastupa ostvaruje 12 momčadi, domaćin te 11 najboljih reprezentacija koje uspješno odrade kvalifikacijski ciklus. Ukupno 54 momčadi ulazi u bubanj kvalifikacija te su raspoređene u devet grupa po šest reprezentacija. Sve reprezentacije u skupini odigraju međusobne susrete doma i u gostima. Devet prvoplasiranih reprezentacija u svakoj grupi ostvaruju izravan plasman na završnicu dok četiri najbolje drugoplasirane reprezentacije preko playoffa love posljednja dva mjesta u završnici Europskog prvenstva...

programme.title: Dinamo Predavac - Dinamo, SuperSport Croatian Football Cup 2025/2026. / Dinamo Predavac - Dinamo, SuperSport Hrvatski nogometni kup 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Football - Croatian Cup - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025) The Croatian Cup is the most massive football competition in Croatia. The Cup was founded in 1992 under the authority of the Croatian Football Federation, and the first winner was an inker from Zapresic. A total of five teams won the Cup, and the most successful is Zagreb's Dinamo in front of Split Hajduk. In the final phase of the Cup, 48 teams compete, the 16 best clubs per coefficient, 21 winners of the county competitions and 11 defeated in the finals of the county competitions. The play is played on the playoffs on one game except the quarterfinals and the semifinals when two matches are played ... / Football - Croatian Cup - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Hrvatski kup najmasovnije je nogometno natjecanje u Hrvatskoj. Kup je osnovan 1992. godine pod ingerencijom Hrvatskog nogometnog saveza, a prvi osvajač bio je Inker iz Zaprešića. Ukupno pet momčadi osvajalo je kup, a najuspješniji je zagrebački Dinamo ispred splitskog Hajduka. U završnoj fazi kupa natječe se 48 momčadi, 16 najboljih klubova po koeficijentu, 21 pobjednik županijskih natjecanja te 11 poraženih u finalima županijskim natjecanjima. Igra se po principu doigravanja na jednu utakmicu izuzev četvrtfinala i polufinala kada se igraju dva susreta...

programme.desc: UEFA European Under -21 Championship Qualification - (Sport. At the final of the main competition, the right of performing is achieved by 12 teams, hosts and the 11 best teams that successfully perform a qualifying cycle. Ukupno 54 momčadi ulazi u bubanj kvalifikacija te su raspoređene u devet grupa po šest reprezentacija. Sve reprezentacije u skupini odigraju međusobne susrete doma i u gostima. programme.title: Leiden auf vier Pfoten
programme.desc: Millions of pets in Germany suffer from agony: from shortness of breath and headache, for example because the brain does not fit into small breeding pads. Pain and suffering - only for the look. Dwarfspitz, pug, the French bulldog or Persian cats are a symbol of a trend that provides homage to health. Despite the agony paragraph in the Animal Welfare Act, which prohibits the breeding of sick vertebrates, more than 50 dog breeds, a dozen cat breeds as well as guinea pigs, rabbits or ornamental birds are affected in Germany. The ARD Story reveals violations at dog exhibitions and documents how breeds are issued and pretended despite the ban on exhibitions, which have the agony characteristics. A hidden SWR research shows that expensive dwarf spitz puppies are sold without examining the parents for hereditary diseases. Animal pathologist Prof. Achim Gruber: "We breeded many breeds." Is Germany ready to increase the law? / Millionen Haustiere in Deutschland leiden unter Qualzuchten: etwa unter Atemnot und Kopfschmerzen, weil das Hirn nicht in klein gezuchtete Schadel passt. Schmerzen und Leiden - nur fur das Aussehen. Zwergspitz, Mops, die franzosische Bulldogge oder Perserkatzen sind Symbol eines Trends, der Schonheit uber Gesundheit stellt. Trotz des Qualzuchtparagrafen im Tierschutzgesetz, der die Zucht von kranken Wirbeltieren verbietet, sind in Deutschland mehr als 50 Hunderassen, ein Dutzend Katzenrassen sowie Meerschweinchen, Kaninchen oder Ziervogel betroffen. Die ARD Story deckt VerstoSSe auf Hundeausstellungen auf und dokumentiert, wie trotz Ausstellungsverbots Rassen ausgestellt und pramiert werden, die Qualzuchtmerkmale aufweisen. Eine verdeckte SWR-Recherche zeigt, dass teure Zwergspitz-Welpen verkauft werden, ohne die Eltern auf Erbkrankheiten untersucht zu haben. Tierpathologe Prof. Achim Gruber: "Wir haben viele Rassen kaputt gezuchtet." Ist Deutschland bereit, das Gesetz zu verscharfen?

programme.title: Echtes Leben
programme.sub-title: Under pressure - pastor Anja and the church asylum / Unter Druck - Pastorin Anja und das Kirchenasyl
programme.desc: The state of Bremen is considered a stronghold of the church asylum: 200 of the almost 2,400 cases nationwide were registered here in 2024. In the Advent season, of all people, the liberal Hanseatic city led to a scandal last year: the interior senator instructed its police to get a 25-year Somalier out of the church asylum and take it in custody in order to deport him to Finland. However, a human chain prevented the officials from entering the Bremen Zion community center. The consequence of the failed deportation: public controversy, unsettled communities, uncertained church superiors and tubular agents. What concretely means church asylum, the film uses the example of people who currently live in church asylum, as well as those who have used it in the past and are still closely connected to the community. In her work, Pastor Anja has to deal with agents. And there are also practical questions of everyday life, from food to language lessons. Because it means an enormous effort for a community to accommodate and look after people for over months. In 2013, every asylum seeker has the right to submit an urgent application to the administrative court against an deportation notice. Critics of the church asylum see the approach of the parishes as unnecessary. The migration researcher Stefan Luft speaks of "a certain way of being" from the university Bremen, he says that the churches have been massively intervene in the enforcement of the right to remedy and asylum. On the other hand, pastor Anja sees herself as a "mug-maker". This role understanding is particularly important to her in church asylum. Since 2017 she has been fleeing people to flee to Hartefall, who rely on the church asylum as the last hope. But their work increasingly got between the fronts. It belongs to your Christian conviction that it should be heard on a case -by -case basis why a person is looking for the help of your community in need. At the same time, she is criticized by outdoors that she is overriding state action in migration policy. Can church do an integration work that the state does not create? Or do pastors use a privilege here contrary to the will of society? / Das Land Bremen gilt als Hochburg des Kirchenasyls: 200 der insgesamt knapp 2.400 Falle bundesweit wurden 2024 hier registriert. Ausgerechnet in der Adventszeit kam es in der liberalen Hansestadt letztes Jahr zum Eklat: Der Innensenator wies seine Polizei an, einen 25-jahrigen Somalier aus dem Kirchenasyl zu holen und in Gewahrsam zu nehmen, um ihn nach Finnland abschieben zu konnen. Eine Menschenkette hinderte die Beamten jedoch daran, das Bremer Zion-Gemeindezentrum zu betreten. Die Folge der gescheiterten Abschiebung: offentliche Kontroversen, verunsicherte Gemeinden, verschnupfte Kirchenobere und verargerte Behorden.Was Kirchenasyl konkret bedeutet, zeigt der Film am Beispiel von Menschen, die aktuell im Kirchenasyl leben, sowie von denen, die es in der Vergangenheit in Anspruch genommen haben und der Gemeinde bis heute eng verbunden sind. In ihrer Arbeit muss sich Pastorin Anja mit Behorden auseinandersetzen. Und es stellen sich auch praktische Fragen des alltaglichen Lebens, vom Essen bis zum Sprachunterricht. Denn es bedeutet einen enormen Aufwand fur eine Gemeinde, Menschen uber Monate unterzubringen, zu ernahren und zu betreuen.Seit 2013 hat jeder Asylsuchende das Recht, gegen einen Abschiebungsbescheid einen Eilantrag beim Verwaltungsgericht zu stellen. Kritiker des Kirchenasyls sehen das Vorgehen der Kirchengemeinden daher als unnotig an. Von "einer gewissen AnmaSSung" spricht der Migrationsforscher Stefan Luft von der Universitat Bremen, er sagt, die Kirchen wurden in den Vollzug des Auslander- und Asylrechts massiv eingreifen.Pastorin Anja sieht sich dagegen als "Moglichmacherin". Dieses Rollenverstandnis ist ihr beim Kirchenasyl besonders wichtig. Seit 2017 kummert sie sich um Menschen auf der Flucht, um Hartefalle, die auf das Kirchenasyl als letzte Hoffnung setzen. Doch zunehmend gerat ihre Arbeit zwischen die Fronten. Es gehort zu ihrer christlichen Überzeugung, von Fall zu Fall sich anzuhoren, warum ein Mensch in Not die Hilfe ihrer Gemeinde sucht. Gleichzeitig wird sie immer scharfer von AuSSenstehenden kritisiert, dass sie sich uber das staatliche Handeln in der Migrationspolitik hinwegsetzt.Kann Kirche eine Integrationsarbeit leisten, die der Staat nicht schafft? Oder nutzen Pastorinnen und Pastoren hier ein Privileg entgegen dem Willen der Gesellschaft?

Konnen die Pfefferkorner den Fall losen und gleichzeitig verhindern, dass Jamal den gefahrlichen Weg zuruck nach Afghanistan antritt?

programme.title: Die Pfefferkorner
programme.desc: Benny is a fire and flame: he was selected as a test player for the new online game "Drachen-Arena". programme.title: Quarks im Ersten
programme.sub-title: Unbekannte Unterwelt - Wie funktioniert unsere Kanalisation?
programme.desc: More than one bathtub full of wastewater produces every person in Germany on average per day. Toilet, washing machine, drain - we all spool only. But where does our used water end up? How does drinking water become drinking water again or at least a form of water that is so clean that it can look back into nature? "Quarks" climbs into the underground world of sewage system and accompanies the path of the wastewater from the toilet to the clarity. What does the sewer network look like under our feet? And how is the sewage system prepared for upcoming extreme weather? Germany is often the leader in the preparation of wastewater in rankings. "Quarks" explains how we can all help with wastewater treatment - and how we can use our resources even better. / Mehr als eine Badewanne voll Abwasser produziert jede Person in Deutschland durchschnittlich pro Tag. Toilette, Waschmaschine, Abfluss - wir alle spulen immer nur ab. Aber wo landet unser benutztes Wasser? Wie wird aus Abwasser wieder Trinkwasser oder zumindest eine Form von Wasser, die so sauber ist, dass sie zuruck in die Natur kann?"Quarks" steigt in die unterirdische Welt der Kanalisation und begleitet den Weg des Abwassers von der Toilette bis zur Klaranlage. Wie sieht das Kanalnetz unter unseren FuSSen aus? Und wie ist die Kanalisation auf kommende Extremwetter vorbereitet?Deutschland ist in Rankings oft Spitzenreiter bei der Aufbereitung von Abwasser. "Quarks" erklart, wie wir alle bei der Abwasserreinigung helfen konnen - und wie wir unsere Ressourcen noch besser nutzen konnen.

programme.desc: Why can't everything stay the way it is? "Asks Krause at the beginning of the story. Future, all of whom have been able to take the horses for Windrader (Angelika Bottiger), but it is strict with his sister (Rosa Falkenhagen). programme.title: The Croatia thriller: hunt for a dead man / Der Kroatien-Krimi: Jagd auf einen Toten
programme.desc: Commissioner Stascha Novak (Jasmin Gerat) experiences a shock when she discovered a familiar necklace on a burned body. The head of the Split homicide commission believes that her ex-fishing Milan (Henning Vogt) was the victim of a disguised murder attack. However, it soon shows that the dead person is someone else: Gore Memic (Robert Besta) from a famous mafia clan of the capital Zagreb. Now Milan is suspected of having exchanged his death in order to go into being. How close she is to the durable night club owner, Stascha does not mention her superior Kovacic (Max Herbrechter) as well as a violent examination of Memic the evening before in Milan's club. She believed that in which Bargast had the rapist of her younger sister Minka (Jenny Meyer) in front of her. However, Minka vehemently deny this and even surprises later with accusations against Milan. Has Stascha completely exchanged in her great love? In the meantime, the commissioner trusts her "ex" everything - from dirty ones to violent crimes. To find him, she even rushes the underworld boss Zlatan Memic (Ralf Dittrich) on his neck, who liked his son. Stasha's plan to let the mafia drive to the search, but harbors incalculable risks. / Kommissarin Stascha Novak (Jasmin Gerat) erlebt einen Schock, als sie eine ihr vertraute Halskette an einer verbrannten Leiche entdeckt. Die Leiterin der Mordkommission Split glaubt, dass ihr Ex-Verlobter Milan (Henning Vogt) das Opfer eines getarnten Mordanschlags wurde. Schon bald zeigt sich jedoch, dass es sich bei dem Toten um jemand anderen handelt: Gore Memic (Robert Besta) aus einem beruchtigten Mafiaclan der Hauptstadt Zagreb. Nun steht Milan unter dem Verdacht, seinen Tod vorgetauscht zu haben, um unterzutauchen. Wie nahe sie dem fluchtigen Nachtklubbesitzer steht, verschweigt Stascha ihrem Vorgesetzten Kovacic (Max Herbrechter) ebenso wie eine heftige Auseinandersetzung mit Memic am Vorabend in Milans Klub. Sie glaubte, in dem Bargast den Vergewaltiger ihrer jungeren Schwester Minka (Jenny Meyer) vor sich zu haben. Minka verneint dies aber vehement und uberrascht spater sogar mit Anschuldigungen gegen Milan. Hat sich Stascha in ihrer groSSen Liebe komplett getauscht? Inzwischen traut die Kommissarin ihrem "Ex" alles zu - von schmutzigen Geschaften bis zu Gewaltverbrechen. Um ihn ausfindig zu machen, hetzt sie ihm sogar den Unterweltboss Zlatan Memic (Ralf Dittrich) auf den Hals, der seinen Sohn rachen mochte. Staschas Plan, sich von der Mafia zu dem Gesuchten fuhren zu lassen, birgt jedoch unkalkulierbare Risiken.

How do you stop on an emergency call, how does first aid work and what happens in an ambulance? In their humorous and encouraging way, the sanitators and influencers show how everyone can provide first aid in an emergency. With their profit, the classes support the children's aid campaign "Heart Safe" by SWR and SR. / Bei einem Notfall werden sie gerufen! Christian Manshen und Mike Rauch geben im "Tigerenten Club" Einblicke in ihren Job als Notfallsanitater. Wie verhalt man sich bei einem Notruf, wie funktioniert Erste Hilfe und was passiert in einem Rettungswagen? Die Sanitater und Influencer zeigen in ihrer humorvollen und ermutigenden Art, wie jeder im Ernstfall Erste Hilfe leisten kann.In der Spielearena spielen die Frosche von der Realschule Rheinstetten gegen die Tigerenten vom Erasmus-Widmann-Gymnasium aus Schwabisch Hall um den Goldpokal. programme.title: Unheimlich perfekte Freunde
programme.desc: Emil and Frido are best friends. When the mirror images of the two are brought to life in a mirror cabinet, the ten -year boys believe that they have pulled the big lot: the double gangs can do everything that Frido and Emil themselves cannot do so well, but they expect their ambitious parents from them. But when their images suddenly begin to pursue their own goals, the two friends have to find a way to get rid of the uncanny spirits they called. But that is more difficult than expected. / Emil und Frido sind beste Freunde. Als in einem Spiegelkabinett auf dem Jahrmarkt die Spiegelbilder der beiden zum Leben erweckt werden, glauben die zehnjahrigen Jungs, das groSSe Los gezogen zu haben: Die Doppelganger konnen namlich all das, was Frido und Emil selbst nicht so gut konnen, ihre ambitionierten Eltern aber von ihnen erwarten. Doch als ihre Abbilder plotzlich beginnen, eigene Ziele zu verfolgen, mussen die beiden Freunde einen Weg finden, die unheimlichen Geister, die sie riefen, wieder loszuwerden. Das aber gestaltet sich schwieriger als gedacht.

programme.title: Tiere bis unters Dach
programme.desc: Jakob's seventiest birthday is imminent. His childhood friend Otto suddenly appears, who makes a surprise visit with his elderly Labrador Hannibal. Jakob didn't really want to celebrate. But in contrast to Jakob, Otto is a happy journeyman who, especially through Hannibal, conquered the hearts of the children at the horse farm and reminds Jakob of an old promise that must now be accorded. The promise means a lot of fun, but no peace. But shortly before the big day, Hannibal collapses. Kajo's diagnosis is clear: the Labrador has a tumor. Can the children's darling be saved? What will become of Jakob's birthday party? / Jakobs siebzigster Geburtstag steht bevor. Plotzlich taucht sein Jugendfreund Otto auf, der mit seinem betagten Labrador Hannibal einen Überraschungsbesuch macht. Jakob wollte eigentlich keinesfalls feiern. Doch Otto ist im Gegensatz zu Jakob ein frohlicher Geselle, der vor allem durch Hannibal die Herzen der Kinder auf dem Pferdehof erobert und Jakob an ein altes Versprechen erinnert, das jetzt eingelost werden musse. Das Versprechen bedeutet viel SpaSS, aber keine Ruhe. Doch kurz vor dem groSSen Tag bricht Hannibal zusammen. Kajos Diagnose ist eindeutig: Der Labrador hat einen Tumor. Kann der Liebling der Kinder noch gerettet werden? Was wird aus Jakobs Geburtstagsfeier?

Als Sabrina, die attraktive Ex-Freundin von Kajo, mit ihrer Tochter Zoe zum Tennisturnier in Waldau erscheint, nutzt Sam die Gelegenheit, die Fahigkeiten der Schildkrote ausgiebig zu testen. Denn er mochte der hubschen Zoe imponieren. Auch Valentin zeigt groSSes Interesse an Sammy, denn er mochte durch Wetten beim Tennisturnier den groSSen Reibach machen. programme.desc: Eddie and her new partner are called for a predatory case. To her surprise, the tider is already tied up with handcuffs when they arrive. programme.title: While 1 / Dok 1
programme.sub-title: Three weeks of cell phone withdrawal: the experiment / Drei Wochen Handy-Entzug: Das Experiment
programme.desc: Headache, unrest, nervousness, aggression and phantom bells: the withdrawal symptoms among the young people are violent. The missing cell phone is to blame. 69 young people for Dok 1 An experiment and forego their mobile device for three weeks. Means: no social media, no news, no communication. Above all, the beginning is hard, because young people spend an average of about five hours a day with their cell phone and belong to a generation that often does not know what it is like to live without a smartphone. After four to five days, the young people discover the positive sides of the withdrawal. The extraordinary experiment is scientifically accompanied by the Anton-Proksch Institute and the Sigmund-Freud private university in Vienna. A DOK 1 that looks deep into the world of real and thought of the 16-year schoolchildren and shows how dependent we are all about our smartphones. The hip-hop superstar Raf Camora, who grew up in Vienna, also knows this dependence. After an obese, he prescribed an eight-month social media break. He makes an exception for DOK 1 and describes in one of his extraordinary interviews how his life has improved. / Kopfschmerzen, Unruhe, Nervositat, Aggressionen und Phantomklingeln: Die Entzugserscheinungen bei den Jugendlichen sind heftig. Schuld daran ist das fehlende Handy. 69 Jugendliche wagen fur Dok 1 ein Experiment und verzichten drei Wochen auf ihr Mobilgerat. HeiSSt: Keine sozialen Medien, keine Nachrichten, keine Kommunikation. Vor allem der Anfang ist hart, denn Jugendliche verbringen im Schnitt etwa funf Stunden pro Tag mit ihrem Handy und gehoren zu einer Generation, die oft nicht weiSS, wie es ist, ohne Smartphone zu leben. Nach vier bis funf Tagen entdecken die Jugendlichen die positiven Seiten des Entzugs. Das auSSergewohnliche Experiment wird wissenschaftlich vom Anton-Proksch-Institut und der Sigmund-Freud Privatuniversitat in Wien begleitet. Eine Dok 1, die tief in die Gefuhls- und Gedankenwelt von 16-jahrigen Schulerinnen und Schulern blickt und zeigt, wie abhangig wir alle mittlerweile von unseren Smartphones sind. Auch der in Wien aufgewachsene Hip-Hop Superstar RAF Camora kennt diese Abhangigkeit. Er hat sich nach einem Gehorsturz eine acht-monatige social media-Pause verordnet. Fur die Dok 1 macht er eine Ausnahme und beschreibt in einem seiner auSSerst seltenen Interviews, wie sich sein Leben dadurch verbessert hat.

programme.title: We have to talk! / Wir mussen reden!
programme.desc: Following the experiment, Lisa Gadstatters for a stimulating round of conversation in the ORF1 Talk Studio. Those responsible, experts and those affected discuss their immediate reactions, exchange their points of view and views and look ahead: How can we classify the results of the experiment for us as a society? How do we deal with what we saw there? What conclusions do we draw for our everyday life and where is there a need for politics? / Im Anschluss an das Experiment ladt Lisa Gadenstatter zu einer anregenden Gesprachsrunde in das ORF1 Talk-Studio. Verantwortliche, ExpertInnen und Betroffene diskutieren ihre unmittelbaren Reaktionen, tauschen ihre Standpunkte und Ansichten aus und schauen nach vorne: Wie konnen wir die Ergebnisse des Experiments fur uns als Gesellschaft einordnen? Wie gehen wir mit dem um, was wir da gesehen haben? Welche Schlussfolgerungen fur unseren Alltag ziehen wir und wo besteht Handlungsbedarf fur die Politik?

programme.title: Smartphone-Verbot fur Spaniens Kinder?
programme.desc: A revolt from Spain: In Barcelona, ​​the movement is committed to banning teenagers without a cell phone to simply ban smartphones before the age of 16. A demand with a large scope, because 80 percent of the 12-year Spanish children already have a smartphone. After revenge porn and scandal-fare affarities with minor year on social media, the goal is clear: no smartphones for young people under the age of 16. In September 2023, the movement was only supported by a dozen parents - today there are already 60,000. / Eine Revolte aus Spanien: In Barcelona setzt sich die Bewegung Teenager ohne Handy dafur ein, Smartphones vor dem Alter von 16 Jahren schlichtweg zu verbieten. Eine Forderung mit groSSer Tragweite, denn 80 Prozent der 12-jahrigen spanischen Kinder besitzen bereits ein Smartphone. Nach Rache-Pornos und skandaltrachtigen Affaren mit Minderjahrigen in den sozialen Medien ist das Ziel klar: Keine Smartphones fur Jugendliche unter 16 Jahren. Im September 2023 wurde die Bewegung nur von einem Dutzend Eltern unterstutzt - heute sind es bereits 60.000.

programme.title: While 1 / Dok 1
programme.sub-title: Three weeks of cell phone withdrawal: the experiment / Drei Wochen Handy-Entzug: Das Experiment
programme.desc: Headache, unrest, nervousness, aggression and phantom bells: the withdrawal symptoms among the young people are violent. The missing cell phone is to blame. 69 young people for Dok 1 An experiment and forego their mobile device for three weeks. Means: no social media, no news, no communication. Above all, the beginning is hard, because young people spend an average of about five hours a day with their cell phone and belong to a generation that often does not know what it is like to live without a smartphone. After four to five days, the young people discover the positive sides of the withdrawal. The extraordinary experiment is scientifically accompanied by the Anton-Proksch Institute and the Sigmund-Freud private university in Vienna. A DOK 1 that looks deep into the world of real and thought of the 16-year schoolchildren and shows how dependent we are all about our smartphones. The hip-hop superstar Raf Camora, who grew up in Vienna, also knows this dependence. After an obese, he prescribed an eight-month social media break. He makes an exception for DOK 1 and describes in one of his extraordinary interviews how his life has improved. / Kopfschmerzen, Unruhe, Nervositat, Aggressionen und Phantomklingeln: Die Entzugserscheinungen bei den Jugendlichen sind heftig. Schuld daran ist das fehlende Handy. 69 Jugendliche wagen fur Dok 1 ein Experiment und verzichten drei Wochen auf ihr Mobilgerat. HeiSSt: Keine sozialen Medien, keine Nachrichten, keine Kommunikation. Vor allem der Anfang ist hart, denn Jugendliche verbringen im Schnitt etwa funf Stunden pro Tag mit ihrem Handy und gehoren zu einer Generation, die oft nicht weiSS, wie es ist, ohne Smartphone zu leben. Nach vier bis funf Tagen entdecken die Jugendlichen die positiven Seiten des Entzugs. Das auSSergewohnliche Experiment wird wissenschaftlich vom Anton-Proksch-Institut und der Sigmund-Freud Privatuniversitat in Wien begleitet. Eine Dok 1, die tief in die Gefuhls- und Gedankenwelt von 16-jahrigen Schulerinnen und Schulern blickt und zeigt, wie abhangig wir alle mittlerweile von unseren Smartphones sind. Auch der in Wien aufgewachsene Hip-Hop Superstar RAF Camora kennt diese Abhangigkeit. Er hat sich nach einem Gehorsturz eine acht-monatige social media-Pause verordnet. Fur die Dok 1 macht er eine Ausnahme und beschreibt in einem seiner auSSerst seltenen Interviews, wie sich sein Leben dadurch verbessert hat.

programme.title: We, the youth of Iran / Wir, die Jugend des Iran
programme.desc: With the violent death of student Jina Mahsa Amini in police custody, three years ago, the greatest wave of protest in Iran since the state base in 1979. Nationwide, young people have been on the road nationwide, opposed the authority of the Mullah regime and demanded their freedom. The protests were bloodily depressed, but the change in Iranian youth continues unstoppably. Based on the stories of six young women, the world journal shows an extraordinary insight into the young, educated social class of Iran. 60% of the population is under 35 years. Their life is characterized by state repression and Willkur, of economic crisis and unemployment, but many are politicized, feminist, grun and networked. "It is the country that has to arise, not me," says a young student - and speaks from the heart of many people in Iran. Design: Solène Chalvon -Fioriti / Mit dem gewaltsamen Tod der Studentin Jina Mahsa Amini in Polizeigewahrsam begann vor drei Jahren die groSSte Protestwelle im Iran seit der Staatsgrundung 1979. Landesweit gingen junge Menschen auf die StraSSe, widersetzten sich der Autoritat des Mullah-Regimes und forderten ihre Freiheit ein. Die Proteste wurden blutig niedergeschlagen, doch die Wandlung der iranischen Jugend geht unaufhaltsam weiter.Das WELTjournal zeigt anhand der Geschichten von sechs jungen Frauen einen auSSergewohnlichen Einblick in die junge, gebildete Gesellschaftsschicht des Iran. 60% der Bevolkerung sind unter 35 Jahre. Ihr Leben ist gepragt von staatlicher Repression und Willkur, von Wirtschaftskrise und Arbeitslosigkeit, doch viele sind politisiert, feministisch, grun und vernetzt. "Es ist das Land, das sich verandern muss, nicht ich", sagt eine junge Studentin - und spricht damit vielen Menschen im Iran aus dem Herzen.Gestaltung: Solène Chalvon-Fioriti

programme.title: Irans Wasserkrise - Misswirtschaft, Korruption und Klimawandel
programme.desc: Heat, durre and years of mismanagement have brought the Iranian capital Tehran to the edge of a water emergency. Stream and water shutdowns let facts stand still and millions of people without tap water or air conditioning. Finally, a temporary closure of the capital or its long-term relocation was discussed. In the World Journal +, the award-winning Canadian-Iranian documentary filmmaker Gelareh Darabi is followed by the path of the water crisis. Inefficient water management in agriculture, into which 90% of the drinking water flows, and wild growth on Staudammen and fountain have massively strengthened the consequences of climate change in recent decades. 80% of the reservoirs have dried up. The Zayandeh Rud, the once water-rich river of the central Iran, is also dry. Lake Urmia, once one of the largest salt lakes on earth, has shrunk to a tenth of its flat. Meanwhile, the bizarre aesthetics of the dried water attracts photographers. If Iran continues as before, the half of its provinces will be uninhabitable within the next decades. Design: Gelareh Darabi / Hitze, Durre und jahrelanges Missmanagement haben die iranische Hauptstadt Teheran an den Rand eines Wassernotstands gebracht.Strom- und Wasserabschaltungen lassen Fabriken stillstehen und Millionen Menschen ohne Leitungswasser oder Klimaanlage zuruck. Zuletzt wurde sogar eine zeitweilige SchlieSSung der Hauptstadt oder deren langfristige Verlegung diskutiert.Im WELTjournal + verfolgt die preisgekronte kanadisch-iranische Dokumentarfilmerin Gelareh Darabi den Weg der Wasserkrise zuruck an die Anfange. Ineffizientes Wassermanagement in der Landwirtschaft, in die 90% des Trinkwassers flieSSen, und ein Wildwuchs an Staudammen und Brunnen haben in den letzten Jahrzehnten die Folgen des Klimawandels massiv verstarkt. 80% der Stauseen sind ausgetrocknet. Der Zayandeh Rud, der einst wasserreichste Fluss des Zentral-Iran, ist den GroSSteil des Jahres ebenfalls trocken. Der Urmia-See, einst einer der groSSten Salzseen der Erde, ist auf ein Zehntel seiner Flache geschrumpft. Die bizarre Ästhetik der ausgetrockneten Gewasser lockt unterdessen Fotografen an. Macht der Iran weiter wie bisher, wird innerhalb der nachsten Jahrzehnte knapp die Halfte seiner Provinzen unbewohnbar sein.Gestaltung: Gelareh Darabi

programme.title: WeltWeit
programme.sub-title: Lokalaugenschein Grenze. Der Preis fur Sicherheit.
programme.desc: According to the 2015 experience, Europe's escape policy is a policy of foreclosure. In order to keep the so -called "fortress in Europe", Lander with EU external borders are more powerful into the role of "goalkeepers" - with considerable economic and social consequences, apart from the political tensions. And the strengthened border protection has also done something with the respective regions: increased militar deployment, the construction of fence and walls, the use of surveillance technology, all of which leaves clear traces not only for people on site.Benedict Feichtner is in the border area between Poland and Belarus. Belarus, which is committed to Russia, sends escape lodges to the border and thus uses illegal migration as a means of pressure against the EU. Warsaw has now massively expanded border protection, with far -reaching consequences for the last large jungle area in Europe. A meter-high steel fence runs in the middle of the UNESCO World Heritage Site, blocks the hiking trails of Luchsen, Wolfen, Bisons and destroys gentle tourism in the surrounding villages, since large parts of the area have been explained to military restricted areas. A four meter high barbed wire fence with cameras and warm-ups have been used converted a high security zone. So far, the EU's bulwark has cost around 1.5 billion euros. Ernst Gelegs accompanies officials from the Hungarian border police and the Esterreiche police contestation and learns how dangerous their service has become. People in the Hungarian border villages live in a standing state of emergency. On the Serbian side, countless escape in improvised camps or abandoned homes are waiting for an opportunity - often with the help of unscrupulous tugs - to break through 175 kilometers long border fortification on the so -called Balkan route. With its location - only a few kilometers from the Turkische Kuste - has been a main destination for escape areas since 2015. The Greek island is a symbol for solidarity and helpfulness, but also for excessive demands and the failure of the European escape policy. The escape deal with the Turkei has reduced the number of incoming, but many islanders are understood by the EU. Isabella Purkart investigates the question of how much the broken tourism has changed the island and why the protection of the EU outside border Greece still divides, because Lesbos politically symbolizes the EU's dilemma: external border protection versus human rights. / Europas Fluchtlingspolitik ist nach den Erfahrungen von 2015 eine Politik der Abschottung. Um die sogenannte "Festung Europa" zu halten, werden Lander mit EU-AuSSengrenzen starker in die Rolle von "Torwachtern" gedrangt - mit erheblichen wirtschaftlichen und gesellschaftlichen Folgen, von den politischen Spannungen einmal abgesehen. Und der verstarkte Grenzschutz hat auch etwas mit den jeweiligen Regionen gemacht: vermehrte militarische Einsatze, der Bau von Zaunen und Mauern, die Verwendung von Überwachungstechnologie, all das hinterlasst deutliche Spuren nicht nur bei den Menschen vor Ort.Benedict Feichtner ist im Grenzgebiet zwischen Polen und Belarus unterwegs. Das mit Russland verbundete Belarus schickt Fluchtlinge zur Grenze und nutzt so die illegale Migration als Druckmittel gegen die EU. Warschau hat inzwischen den Grenzschutz massiv ausgebaut, mit weitreichenden Folgen fur das dort befindliche letzte groSSe Urwaldgebiet Europas. Ein meterhoher Stahlzaun verlauft mitten durch das UNESCO-Weltnaturerbe, blockiert die Wanderwege von Luchsen, Wolfen, Bisons und zerstort den sanften Tourismus in den umliegenden Dorfern, da groSSe Teile der Gegend zu militarischem Sperrgebiet erklart wurden.Ein vier Meter hoher Stacheldrahtzaun mit Kameras, Bewegungsmeldern und Warmebildgeraten hat die serbisch-ungarische Grenze in eine Hochsicherheitszone verwandelt. Rund 1,5 Milliarden Euro hat das Bollwerk der EU bisher gekostet. Ernst Gelegs begleitet Beamte der ungarischen Grenzpolizei sowie des osterreichischen Polizei-Kontigents und erfahrt, wie gefahrlich ihr Dienst geworden ist. Die Menschen in den ungarischen Grenzdorfern leben im standigen Ausnahmezustand. Auf serbischer Seite warten zahllose Fluchtende in improvisierten Camps oder verlassenen Hausern auf eine Gelegenheit - oft mithilfe skrupelloser Schlepper - , die 175 Kilometer lange Grenzbefestigung auf der sogenannten Balkanroute mit Gewalt zu durchbrechen.Mit seiner Lage - nur wenige Kilometer von der turkischen Kuste entfernt - ist Lesbos seit 2015 ein Hauptankunftsort fur Fluchtende aus Kriegs- und Krisengebieten. Die griechische Insel ist ein Symbol fur Solidaritat und Hilfsbereitschaft, aber auch fur Überforderung und das Scheitern der europaischen Fluchtlingspolitik geworden. Der Fluchtlings-Deal mit der Turkei hat zwar die Zahl der Ankommenden gesenkt, dennoch fuhlen sich viele Inselbewohner von der EU im Stich gelassen. Isabella Purkart geht der Frage nach, wie sehr der eingebrochene Tourismus die Insel verandert hat und warum der Schutz der EU-AuSSengrenze Griechenland bis heute spaltet, denn politisch symbolisiert Lesbos das Dilemma der EU: AuSSengrenzschutz versus Menschenrechte.

programme.title: Der Lissabon-Krimi
programme.desc: Captivating case on the hot pavement of Portugal's pulsating metropolis! With his wife, Witwer Eduardo Silva (Jurgen Tarrach) also lost his daughter Ines (Helen Woigk). The young woman has been going to him since the mother's death. But when I need the father's assistant, Eduardo is naturally immediately on hand. The death of his wife has destroyed the family life of lawyer Eduardo Silva. Since then, his daughter Ines has been sporadically. When she reappears, she needs an alibi. Her friend, the ecotrorist Miguel Alcántara, is suspected of murder. In order to get to him, the public prosecutor's office is under pressure on Ines. In the hope of reducing the gap between them, Eduardo is attached to his daughter. A case that leads the fine -shaped lawyer to his stress limits. / Fesselnder Fall auf dem heiSSen Pflaster von Portugals pulsierender Metropole! Mit seiner Frau hat Witwer Eduardo Silva (Jurgen Tarrach) einst auch seine Tochter Ines (Helen Woigk) verloren. Die junge Frau geht seit dem Tod der Mutter auf Distanz zu ihm. Doch als Ines vaterlichen Beistand braucht, ist Eduardo naturlich sofort zur Stelle.Der Tod seiner Frau hat das Familienleben von Rechtsanwalt Eduardo Silva zerstort. Nur sporadisch schaut seine Tochter Ines seither bei ihm vorbei. Als sie wieder einmal auftaucht, braucht sie ein Alibi. Ihr Freund, der Ökoterrorist Miguel Alcántara, steht unter Mordverdacht. Um an ihn heranzukommen, ubt die Staatsanwaltschaft Druck auf Ines aus. In der Hoffnung, die Kluft zwischen ihnen zu verringern, steht Eduardo seiner Tochter bei. Ein Fall, der den feinfuhligen Juristen an seine Belastungsgrenzen fuhrt.

programme.desc: In einer Rundreise durch die Bucklige Welt, das Wechselland, die Semmering-Rax-Schneeberg-Region und das Schneebergland stellt der Film Menschen vor, die sich der Nachhaltigkeit und einer Besinnung aufs Wesentliche verschrieben haben. programme.title: Unterwegs beim Nachbarn
programme.desc: Celebrating two reasons this year have three city in the Alpine Adria room, which connects a long-term friendship. Klagenfurt am Worthersee has a total of 15 partner city, including Gorz/Gorizia in Friuli Julian Veneto and Neugorz/Nova Gorica in Slovenia. In 2025, the city partnership celebrates its 60-year anniversary. The once divided and reunited city of Gorz, which is located in the Italian territory and its "sister city" Nova Gorica are - in addition to Chemnitz in Germany - also together in the European Capital of Culture. "Go Borderless" is the motto for the common cultural annual program. Grosse names are to be officially lured by culture affine visitors to this year's cultural capital. But above all, there are numerous local artists and smaller initiatives that impart their view of the Capital of Culture. It is often a look into the past combined with hopes for the future. The production "border history (s)" is based on the make-up of various protagonists from Slovenia and Italy of the "soul" of the people who live in the two citys. This "on the go with the neighbor" production should express after a short strain through the common historical past, as the inhabitants of the city of Gorizia and Nova Gorica are currently working together on their appearance in 2025. Economically, culturally and touristically, visitors from near and far are expected throughout and far throughout the region, but the documentation also shows where - apart from the event -related euphoria - synergies can result for the future. The role of the Karntner side - with Klagenfurt am Worthersee as a partner city, and a contribution from the cultural sector with the Ingeborg -Bachmann -Kuppel designed by Armin Guerino - is also illustrated in this context. / Gleich zwei Grunde zu feiern haben heuer drei Stadte im Alpen-Adria-Raum, die eine jahrelange Freundschaft verbindet. Klagenfurt am Worthersee hat insgesamt 15 Partnerstadte, darunter auch Gorz/Gorizia in Friaul Julisch Venetien und Neugorz/Nova Gorica in Slowenien. 2025 feiert die Stadtepartnerschaft ihr 60-jahriges Bestandsjubilaum. Die einst geteilte und wiedervereinte Stadt Gorz, die auf italienischem Staatsgebiet liegt und ihre "Schwesternstadt" Nova Gorica sind heuer - neben Chemnitz in Deutschland - auch gemeinsam Europaische Kulturhauptstadt. "GO borderless" lautet das Motto fur das gemeinsame kulturelle Jahresprogramm.GroSSe Namen sollen von offizieller Seite her kulturaffine Besucher in die heurige Kulturhauptstadt locken. Aber es sind vor allem auch zahlreiche lokale Kunstschaffende und kleinere Initiativen, die ihren Blick auf die Kulturhauptstadt vermitteln. Oft ist es ein Blick in die Vergangenheit, verbunden mit Hoffnungen fur die Zukunft. Die Produktion "Grenz-Geschichte(n)" geht anhand der Erzahlungen verschiedener Protagonisten aus Slowenien und Italien der "Seele" der Menschen auf die Spur, die in den beiden Stadten leben.Diese "Unterwegs beim Nachbarn"-Produktion soll nach einem kurzen Streifzug durch die gemeinsame geschichtliche Vergangenheit zum Ausdruck bringen, wie die Bewohner der Stadte Gorizia und Nova Gorica aktuell gemeinsam an ihrem Auftritt als Kulturhauptstadt 2025 arbeiten. Wirtschaftlich, kulturell und touristisch wird durch Besucher aus Nah und Fern in der gesamten Region ein Aufschwung erwartet.Die Dokumentation zeigt aber auch wo sich - abseits der anlassbezogenen Euphorie - Synergien fur die Zukunft ergeben konnen. Auch die Rolle der Karntner Seite - mit Klagenfurt am Worthersee als Partnerstadt, und einem Beitrag aus dem Kultursektor mit der von Armin Guerino gestalteten Ingeborg-Bachmann-Kuppel - wird in diesem Zusammenhang verdeutlicht.

programme.title: Prisma
programme.desc: Kopftuchverbot, Sterbehilfe, religiose Symbole im Wahlkampf: Religion und Ethik spielen in der offentlichen Diskussion immer wieder eine zentrale Rolle.
